annotations.title: Where a group should meet, by public transport

description:
Suggest railway stations in Switzerland where two to ten people starting from different places can meet by public transport, each with every person's travel time. Two rankings: fairest (the longest journey as short as it can be, and nobody travelling much longer than the others) and least_travel (everybody's minutes added up, keeping to places in between). Well-connected stations get a small bonus, and the suggestions are spread out rather than five suburbs of one town.

Use it for "where should I meet my friend from Basel if I'm in Chur", "a good place for the four of us from Bern, Luzern, Zürich and Basel to meet for lunch", "halfway between Geneva and Lausanne". For the travel times between given places, use travel_time_matrix; for the journey to the place chosen, plan_journey. Each suggestion carries plan_urls, one per person, opening their connections to it on spickme.ch; with two people, open_url opens the meet page with a map.

Inputs: people is the list of starting places in any order (2–10), each A station or stop name ("Zürich HB", "Bern", "Lausanne, Flon"), an address ("Bahnhofplatz 1, Winterthur"), a named place ("ETH Zürich", "Kunsthaus Zürich"), a town's name in English, French or Italian ("Geneva", "Lucerne"), a coordinate as "geo:47.3769,8.5417", or a place_id returned by find_place ("stop:8503000"). Names are read the way a rider types them; an ambiguous name returns candidates instead of a guess. departure is when everybody leaves: Swiss local time in ISO 8601, e.g. "2026-09-26T08:00"; an explicit offset or Z is converted. A bare "08:00" means today (tomorrow if it has long passed). Omit for now. limit is how many suggestions per ranking (1–8, default 5). max_transfers caps changes.

Minutes are from the departure to the arrival at the meeting station, waiting for the first vehicle included, on that day's planned timetable; live delays are not included. A person's own station is never suggested.

Example: {"people": ["Basel", "Chur"], "departure": "2026-09-26T09:00"}

departure.description: When everybody leaves. Omit for now.

max_transfers.description: The most changes of vehicle allowed.

people.description: Where each person starts, 2 to 10 places.

transfer_time_factor.description: How much time to allow for changing trains, as a multiple of the timetable's minimum change times: 1 (default) is the timetable's own; 1.5 for luggage, children or reduced mobility; 0.7 for a fast walker. Between 0.5 and 3.

name: meeting_point
